method_notes: ACL-family authority = aclanthology.org (citation_* meta + official .bib) AND dblp.org (booktitle field). OpenReview was NOT used as authority for ACL-family entries (project rule: OpenReview venueid applies to ICLR/NeurIPS/ICML only).
main-vs-Findings adjudicated ONLY via DBLP booktitle + Anthology anthology-id prefix (S2 venue field does not distinguish main from Findings and was deliberately not used for that decision).
Every claimed DOI was actually dereferenced with curl -sIL and the full redirect chain recorded (not merely format-checked).

Camera-ready PDFs were downloaded and first-page text extracted with pypdf to check the CLAUDE.md caveat that a PDF body title can differ from Anthology metadata, and to independently confirm the printed page range.
arXiv-vs-camera-ready diff done by pulling the arXiv preprint record for each ACL paper and comparing title + author list against Anthology metadata.
